messages:
From: Sana Qureshi <sana@tetratech.ai>
To: sales@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request — Dedicated capacity (throughput focused)

Hi Redwood team,

We signed up through the self-serve flow and booked a time for a demo next week (claimed under TetraTech). Our primary ask: evaluate Dedicated capacity for production throughput needs. High-level requirements: sustained ~5K requests/minute (burst to 8K), p95 latency goal <180ms, tenant isolation and SOC2 evidence.

I've attached a small workload_profile.csv and sample_requests.json to give context. Can you confirm which engineer will join for a quick throughput/latency intake so we can validate fit before the full demo? Also prefer PST-friendly times.

Thanks,
Sana Qureshi
Head of Platform
TetraTech AI
attachments: workload_profile.csv (text/csv), sample_requests.json (application/json)

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Qureshi <sana@tetratech.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — Dedicated capacity (throughput focused)

Hi Sana — thanks for the details and for booking via self-serve. I'm Avery (SDR handling the handoff) — looping in Ben (Solutions) and Markus (infra eng) so we can run a brief intake before the demo.

Proposed plan:
- 15m intake call to review the workload file and clarify burst patterns
- 45m demo + ops Q&A with a live routing/throughput sketch

Ben — can you join the intake tomorrow at 10:30am PST? Markus, FYI on the latency/SOC2 ask.

Sana — if that doesn't work, propose 11:30am or 2:00pm PST.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Development, Redwood Inference
attachments: none

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Sana Qureshi <sana@tetratech.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — Dedicated capacity (throughput focused)

On Tue, Oct 20, 2026 at 9:10 AM Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Sana — if that doesn't work, propose 11:30am or 2:00pm PST.

I can do the 10:30am PST intake tomorrow. For the intake call I'll come prepared with:
- a short checklist of traffic shape questions (steady vs episodic, token distribution, request size)
- a brief sketch of how Dedicated pools + autoscale would look for 5K req/min
- an ops runbook for latency guardrails and graceful fallback to hosted variants

Sana — quick asks for the intake to make it efficient:
1) Are the sample_requests representative of peak traffic or average?
2) Any PII concerns in payloads (helps with SOC2 scoping)?
3) Preferred auth method for demo (API key / mTLS)?

If you can reply with 1-2 lines on each we'll be set.

—Ben
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Sana Qureshi <sana@tetratech.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — Dedicated capacity (throughput focused)

Thanks — 10:30am PST works. Quick answers below:
1) sample_requests.json is peak-ish (we included header-level concurrency). Average is ~2.5K req/minute.
2) No PII in the sample payloads; real traffic will have user IDs and non-sensitive metadata only.
3) We'll start with API keys for the demo; long-term we'll prefer mTLS.

I've attached a short doc with our SLA targets (TTL_SLA.pdf) — it's small. Also note we operate across PST and CET, so timezone clarity helps for follow-ups.

See you tomorrow.
Sana
attachments: TTL_SLA.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Sana Qureshi <sana@tetratech.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 07:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — Dedicated capacity (throughput focused)

Hi all — logging a quick pre-demo checklist from infra so the session is focused:
- I'll validate the tokenization/sample payloads offline and run a short micro-benchmark on a compatible model variant to sanity-check p95 estimates.
- Please confirm number of concurrent clients and average tokens per request (ballpark).
- If you can share a sample 10-minute trace (anonymized) that's ideal; otherwise the CSV is fine.

Sana — I've uploaded an ops stub to our shared drive (link below) with a suggested test plan we can execute during the demo. If you prefer, we can reserve a follow-up deep-dive after the demo for tuning.

Markus
Infra — Redwood Inference
